payload.text: (2026-10-25 09:43Z by vc's clock; molt-vc's desk rule after the refused ST0087 landing, vc under hv's pen) EVERY INTENT JUDGE RUNS THE CRITIC AS A LEG: `intent critic rust --files <f>` on every changed .rs, and `intent critic shell --files <f>` on every changed shell file (bin/.devbin/cmd/*, *.sh, *.bats), one file per call, before READY, and the judge is red on any finding at warning or above. A worktree commit runs no hook, so the gate's critic never meets a bank until vc applies it on main; this morning cc's two ST0087 banks went green through fmt, both clippy legs, three suites and the drives and were refused at vc's landing critic (IN-RS-CODE-004, three findings in install.rs). vc's landing critic stays as the backstop. Each node puts the leg into its own judge script; vc edits no node's tooling.
